test_title: PYST 152: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 06 Feb, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Three different positions of the same dice are shown. Find the number on the face opposite the face showing '6'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/583ac67d72d1bf9d513b0a2250b9ffabe348529774677a754fd45ccfa0735260.png]
solution:
As 1 and 2 are the common faces on both the dice, the remaining faces 3 and 4 are opposite to each other.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5d9dba2f56aeabb5e54a120c8d0e00f8baee687127836bec605ec4072ad3c228.png] 

As 1 and 4 are the common faces on both the dice, the remaining faces 2 and 5 are opposite to each other.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/882f07a6fd0b98c9ac3005c5194c6623d60d70895e7dfb6bcc6f0634d514cd60.png] 

Now, remaining faces 1 and 6 must be opposite to each other.

Therefore, '1' is the number on the face opposite the face showing '6'.

Hence, ‘**1**’ is the correct answer.
